# CONTEXT.md — d2r-mobile glossary

<!-- Generated by skill `init-dsh-project` v1.8 on 2026-10-26.
     For the agent that **uses** this repo: nouns, abbreviations, external coordinates.
     Repo-specific words only. Upstream's own glossary-like material lives in dm/README.md. -->

## 1. In one line

d2r-mobile (this fork) = **the HarmonyOS PC + phone branch of jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile: make the
HarmonyOS port install, import, play and save flawlessly at 60 fps on a MateBook Pro S and a
Mate X5, with touch, keyboard/mouse and gamepad.**

## 2. Nouns

| Term | What it means here | What it does not mean |
|---|---|---|
| **upstream** | `jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile` on GitHub | Our `origin` (`downsea/d2r-mobile`) |
| **shell** | The HarmonyOS app (HAP) without game content: ArkTS + `libdm.so` | The game itself |
| **import pack** | `dm/` generated from the player's files by `d2rm_android.py --target ohos` | The game's own `data/` |
| **import folder** | `D2R Mobile/` holding both `data/` and `dm/`; what the player selects | Either subfolder alone |
| **2in1** | HarmonyOS device type for PCs / laptops (`const.product.devicetype`) | A tablet |
| **PC** | HarmonyOS PC — here, the MateBook Pro S | A Windows / Linux PC |
| **host** | (1) `dm/host/`, the Horizon-OS host layer; (2) the HarmonyOS PC under this VM. Say which. | — |
| **rewrite** | Offline `patch_nso.py` pass over the game's NSO modules | Runtime JIT / emulation |
| **PRODUCT** | The codename in `dm/PRODUCT` tying pack, shell and tools to one source version | The game version |
| **SOT** | `00-epic-sot.md` of a huge epic | The ledger |

## 3. Abbreviations and coordinates

| Abbreviation / name | Full name and coordinates |
|---|---|
| origin | `git@github.com:downsea/d2r-mobile.git` (public fork) |
| upstream | `https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile` |
| PC device | HUAWEI MateBook Pro S, `MOR-M1`, `2in1`, OpenHarmony-7.0.0.109, software `MOR-W52 7.0.0.111`, API 26, arm64-v8a; hdc `172.16.105.1:<port>` from oh-vm `(measured 2026-10-26, oh device info)` |
| Phone device | HUAWEI Mate X5 (foldable); firmware / API **not yet read** (issue 007) |
| Upstream's devices | Mate 90 Pro Max (CMM-AL10), Pura X (VDE-AL00), HarmonyOS 7.0.0.109, API 26 — upstream's results, not ours |
| NVN | Nintendo's graphics API, translated by `dm/gfx` to Vulkan here |
| HAP | HarmonyOS Ability Package |
| hvigor | HarmonyOS build system — driven via `oh build` on this host |
| AGC | AppGallery Connect (certificates, profiles) |

## 4. Numbers and their provenance

| Number | Provenance | Source tag |
|---|---|---|
| 59.7 fps, present interval p50 16.6 / p99 18.1 ms | Mate 90 Pro Max, debug build, Rogue camp, 12 s hitrace | `(upstream-reported)` — not a baseline for us |
| ~30–60 FPS in screenshots | Mate 90 Pro Max, release shell 0.19.6/code125 | `(upstream-reported)`; upstream says "not a performance acceptance" |
| ≈17.4 GB disk for zip + unpacked + in-app copy | Mate 90 Pro Max | `(upstream-reported)` |
| 6,931 XGS shaders, 18 ui-art images in a pack | One fresh pack generation | `(upstream-reported)` |
| HAP `compatibleVersion` 260000026 | HarmonyOS guide signing example | `(upstream-reported)` |

Our own numbers go into the epic SOT with `(measured <date>, <device>, <build>)`.

## 5. Do not call it that

| Not this | This |
|---|---|
| "HarmonyOS NEXT tablet build" | One HAP; PC = `2in1` |
| "the emulator" | compatibility layer / native execution (upstream's wording) |
| "our port" for the HarmonyOS engine work | upstream's HarmonyOS port (by @biglawine); ours is the PC + phone polish |
